'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Daniel Stephens DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Daniel Stephens]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
